This is one of numerous genera with the common name "lily" due to their flower shape and growth habit.  However, they are only distantly related to the true lily, "Lilium".

As currently circumscribed, the genus includes only two known species, most former species having been moved into the genus "Acis".  Both genera are known as snowflakes.

Crossyne | Crossyne is a genus of African plants in the Amaryllis family.
